online_incident.mitigation: restore exact pre-assume submission bytes and reject T.assume in the online compatibility policy

synchronized_mechanisms.submission_adaptation: retained in the padded online ABI

synchronized_mechanisms.formal: expert-index and compact-row T.assume contracts remain enabled in the measured compact formal kernel
synchronized_mechanisms.submission_adaptation: disabled because the first online evaluation of the adapted assumptions produced a native segmentation fault

policy: Every formal SOTA must be adapted to submission.py when the online ABI and toolchain can safely express it. A mechanism that causes a native online failure must be disabled, documented as an incompatible fallback, guarded by policy, and re-enabled only after exact online-toolchain evidence. Compact and padded address contracts must never be copied blindly.
